correctness.rationale: For a,b>1 and lambda real, S=x^2+y^2, E=x^2/a+y^2/b-1, R=(1-S)(-lambda E+2(a-b)xy), Omega=-2ab(SE-S+1). Independent symbolic differentiation confirms dot S and dot E identities and d(log rho)/dt=-(lambda/ab)Omega for rho=S(S-1)/(-E). Within closed annulus 1<=S<=1/d(theta), angular speed Omega=2ab[S(1-E)-1]>0; at fixed angle rho strictly increases 0 to infinity, giving a smooth full annulus coordinate. Therefore d(log rho)/dtheta=-lambda/ab globally and return rho -> exp(-2pi lambda/(ab))rho; boundary attraction/period foliation follow from monotone angle. Original-time integrals on circle and ellipse give T_C=pi/sqrt(ab(a-1)(b-1)), T_E=T_C-pi/(ab) for all a,b>1. No outside-annulus or original-time uniform-angle conclusion.
